items.source:
Use this factory method to add supplier of initial "seeding" bookmarks to the
transaction managers
items.translation: 使用此工厂方法将初始“播种”书签的供应商添加到事务管理器中。

items.source:
While this class will make sure that the supplier will be accessed in a thread-safe
manner, it is the caller's duty to provide a thread safe supplier (not changing the
seed during a call, etc.).
items.translation: 虽然该类可确保以线程安全的方式访问该供应器，但调用方有责任提供线程安全的供应器（例如，在调用过程中不改变种子等）。

items.source: Returns the default bookmark manager.
items.translation: 返回默认书签管理器。

items.source: Returns the default reactive version of bookmark manager.
items.translation: 返回书签管理器的默认响应式版本。

items.source: A hook for bookmark managers supporting events.
items.translation: 支持事件处理的书签管理器钩子。

items.source:
In a cluster this can be a sensible approach only and if only you can tolerate
stale reads and are not in danger of overwriting old data.
items.translation: 在集群中，这可能是一种合理的做法，但前提是您可以容忍读取过时数据，并且没有覆盖旧数据的风险。

items.source: Refreshes the bookmark manager with the newBookmarks new bookmarks received after the last transaction committed. The collection of usedBookmarks should be removed from the list of known bookmarks.
items.translation: 在最后一次事务提交后接收到的newBookmarks新书签会刷新书签管理器。应将usedBookmarks集合从已知书签列表中移除。

items.source: Refreshes the bookmark manager with the newBookmarks new bookmarks received after the last transaction committed.
items.translation: 在最后一次事务提交后，使用接收到的newBookmarks新书签刷新书签管理器。

items.source: Responsible for storing, updating and retrieving the bookmarks of Neo4j's transaction.
items.translation: 负责存储、更新和检索 Neo4j 事务的书签。

items.source: No need to introspect this collection ever.
items.translation: 无需再审视此系列。

items.source:
Use this bookmark manager at your own risk, it will effectively disable any
bookmark management by dropping all bookmarks and never supplying any.
items.translation: 请谨慎使用此书签管理器，因为它会通过删除所有书签并永不提供新书签的方式，彻底禁用任何书签管理功能。

items.source:
No need to introspect this collection ever. The Neo4j driver will together with the
cluster figure out which of the bookmarks is the most recent one.
items.translation: 无需在此集合中进行内省。Neo4j 驱动程序将与集群协作，自动确定哪个书签是最新的。

items.source: bookmarksSupplier - a supplier for seeding bookmarks, can be null. The supplier is free to provide different bookmarks on each call.
items.translation: bookmarksSupplier - 用于播种书签的供应者，可为 null。该供应者在每次调用时可自由提供不同的书签。

items.source: bookmarksSupplier - a supplier for seeding bookmarks, can be null. The supplier is free to provide different bookmarks on each call
items.translation: bookmarksSupplier - 用于播种书签的供应者，可以为 null。该供应者在每次调用时可提供不同的书签。

items.source: usedBookmarks - the collection of bookmarks known prior to the end of a transaction
items.translation: usedBookmarks - 事务结束前已知的书签集合

items.source: newBookmarks - the bookmarks received after the end of a transaction
items.translation: newBookmarks - 事务结束后接收到的书签

items.source: applicationEventPublisher - an event publisher. If null, no events will be published.
items.translation: applicationEventPublisher - 事件发布器。如果为 null，则不会发布任何事件。

items.source:
a noop bookmark manager, dropping new bookmarks immediately, never
supplying bookmarks.
items.translation: 一个无操作的书签管理器，立即丢弃新书签，从不提供书签。

items.source: a collection of currently known bookmarks
items.translation: 目前已知书签的集合

items.source:
Use this bookmark manager at your own risk, it will effectively disable any
bookmark management by dropping all bookmarks and never supplying any. In a cluster
you will be at a high risk of experiencing stale reads. In a single instance it
will most likely not make any difference.
items.translation: 请谨慎使用此书签管理器，因为它会通过删除所有书签且不再提供任何书签来有效禁用任何书签管理功能。在集群环境中，您将面临极高的读取陈旧数据风险；而在单实例环境中，这通常不会产生任何影响。
